Maya (eng-ml): Quick question — can we allow temporary capture of ephemeral request context for debugging a flaky generation? I want to capture prompt + the last 3 messages and the runtime KV-cache snapshot for up to 1 hour in a secured S3 bucket. Who needs to approve and what redaction rules do we enforce?

Ash (sec): Short answer: maybe. Conditions: (1) strip/replace any bearer/API tokens and auth headers, (2) redact or hash user identifiers (user_id, email, phone), (3) do NOT keep full conversation dumps longer than 1 hour, (4) sample size limit (<=10 requests). No raw token storage ever. Please propose an exact capture list. :lock:

Lee (eng-runtime): For KV cache: please don't snapshot raw auth tokens or third-party cookies. KV should only capture model keys (kv ids) and message text — and even then mask emails/PII. If you need a quick redaction script I can drop one here.

Maya (eng-ml): Proposed capture list: request headers (only non-sensitive headers), request body prompt (first 2k chars), last 3 chat turns, KV indices metadata (no raw KV values), runtime logs for that request. Will hash user_id with SHA256, replace emails with `<email_redacted>`, phones with `<phone_redacted>`. No Authorization header.

Ash (sec): That sounds reasonable. A few clarifications: - Hashing user_id ok, but store hash prefix only (first 8 chars) so debugging still groups sessions but is irreversible. - Replace any token-like strings matching `(?i)bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9\-\._~\+\/]+=*` or `x-api-key\s*[:=]\s*[A-Za-z0-9\-\._~\+\/]+=*` with `<TOKEN_REDACTED>`. - Emails: `\b[\w.%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b` -> `<EMAIL_REDACTED>`. - Phone: simple `\+?\d[\d\s\-()]{6,}\d` -> `<PHONE_REDACTED>`. - Limit capture to 10 requests and retention to 1 hour. Add an audit ticket and list approvers.

Lee (eng-runtime): Example redaction snippet (small):

```python
import re, hashlib

EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"\\b[\\w.%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\\b")
TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)(bearer\\s+[A-Za-z0-9\\-\\._~\\+\\/]+=*|x-api-key\\s*[:=]\\s*[A-Za-z0-9\\-\\._~\\+\\/]+=*)")
PHONE_RE = re.compile(r"\\+?\\d[\\d\\s\\-()]{6,}\\d")

def redacted(s):
    s = TOKEN_RE.sub('<TOKEN_REDACTED>', s)
    s = EMAIL_RE.sub('<EMAIL_REDACTED>', s)
    s = PHONE_RE.sub('<PHONE_REDACTED>', s)
    return s

# example hash for user id
def hash_uid(uid):
    return hashlib.sha256(uid.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
```

Maya (eng-ml): Nice, we'll use that. Is an async approval ok? I can file a ticket in #eng-ops with the sample list and attach the redaction script. We need a short-term S3 role for the debugging engineers.

Jon (eng-platform): I'm fine to approve a one-time role for up to 2 hours once sec signs off and the ticket includes: exact S3 path, list of request IDs (<=10), retention TTL = 1 hour, and who accessed it. I'll grant a scoped IAM role and enable CloudTrail for the object. :thumbsup:

Ash (sec): Approving pending ticket with the above items and link to the redaction script. Also require that KV cache snapshots exclude any keys named `auth*`, `token*`, or `session*`. If any sampled prompt appears to contain credentials, abort and delete immediately, notify sec.

Maya (eng-ml): Acknowledged — will redact and exclude those keys. Filing ticket now.

sec-bot: TEMP_ACCESS_REQUESTED requester=Maya path=s3://redwood-debug/ephemeral/2112345678 sample_count=3 retention=1h

sec-bot: TEMP_ACCESS_GRANTED requester=Maya role=debugger-limited duration=2h audit_id=AZ12345 link=https://audit.internal/AZ12345 :lock:

Maya (eng-ml): Thanks all — will paste ticket link here + the list of request IDs once created.

Ash (sec): One more thing: add a short post-mortem entry describing what we found and confirm deletion of the captures. Preferably a tiny eval of whether redaction trimmed useful debugging context.

Lee (eng-runtime): If you want, I can add a small middleware that auto-applies the redaction before writing to S3 — reduces human error.

Maya (eng-ml): Yes please, that would be great. I'll DM the team for rollout times. :wave:
